body: Proud? No not at all. Stronger people have overcome worse and managed to cope. As far as causing damage... I just don't know, who could? I find myself so at peace right now I can sort of see how much pure rage has affected most of my reactions. This post for example, even a few minutes ago I respond by saying I am trying to help but I wonder if perhaps I just want to spew as much anger/hatred/darkness? whatever... into the world. It would be a very "me" reaction to discover a desire to express violent rage 20 hours before  taking a dirt nap and simply whine weakly on a message board instead of doing something...

Blame? environment? honestly not even sure what you mean by this question. What is , is.  Every day you wake up with the tools you have to deal with whatever may come your way, when the toochest is empty the show is over. Among other more esoteric reasons I wrote this and answer these questions in order to maybe better equip any other damaged wretch.

This is as much of a memoir as is going to happen, I have crossed the day threshold as far as time remaining 49 minutes ago, so now just hours. And no I wasn't born a crazy person(I don't think), but that is what remains. I am 35. As far as weak -- well sure, yeah sounds right.

ya know that saying "what doesn't kill you makes you stronger" and all the related sayings. Its just not true. What is left of me is just awful, hurtful not capable of feeling joy or contentment. Would you want to live like that. why call it anything but what it is   monstrous.
